IT'S A SCAM

sub: The BBB is seeing more task-based job scams that take money from people who thought they got a real job.

slides.title: What it looks like
slides.body:
A text or direct message offers online work: rating products, reviewing businesses, clicking ads or other simple tasks.
Small early payouts build trust. Then you're asked to deposit money, often crypto, to unlock tasks or withdraw your earnings.

slides.title: The red flags
slides.body:
High pay for simple tasks like rating products or liking content.
A recruiter contacts you out of the blue by text, WhatsApp or social media.
Any request to deposit money or crypto to keep working or get paid.
slides.tip: The BBB's rule: never pay to get paid.

slides.title: What to do
slides.body:
Research the company and the job opening on your own before you accept an offer or do any tasks.
If you're asked for fees, taxes or verification charges before you can withdraw, that's part of the scam.

slides.title: Report it
slides.body: Report it to BBB Scam Tracker at BBB.org/scamtracker. Your report helps warn others.
slides.tip: Send this to anyone on your team, or in your family, who's job hunting.
